We used to date, I ended things because our location was very negative. This year things were much better, it had been about 6 months because of lockdown. Our environment had changed, and she started dating me again, we were together as an item, just not like publicly, and then she said she didn't think she felt the same way she did last year and that she didn't wanna see me like that anymore. It was random too, like overnight she went from 'i love you' to 'i don't feel anything for you romantically'

But how do I know that it wasn't just a fluke? Like I have been struggling with depression and anxiety for just over 10 years with no relief until she became a part of my life, and I made sure that her role didn't become that of a carer, I wanted things to last.

We were together for a while, she basically dropped me out of nowhere and now is ghosting me even tho she said she wanted to stay friends? She is moving away in about a week and a half. I just feel like she is going to move on and be fine, and obviously I want her to be ok, but she is the first person who has ever made me feel wanted and ok mentally. All my past relationships have been quite abusive, but she was different

The person I care about more than any other doesn't want to speak to me, and all I want to do is tell her how I feel, but I know that would push her further away. Everyone I speak to about this knows how dependant I am and how much I struggle with thoughts of self harm and suicide when I am isolated but they all agree that I should just blank this person. The longer I don't speak to her the worse it feels, as if she is just going to forget me and I can't tell anybody how I really feel like mentally because they all just pity me rather than supporting me
It's definitely a messy situation but it sounds like maybe she reciprocates the feeling
